title: Code for a 2023 social accounting matrix for China with income-decile households and financial accounts
description: Construction, validation, sensitivity and figure-generation code for the 2023 China SAM, with structural concordances and input acquisition instructions. No CFPS household records, original publisher workbooks, internal decile tables or generated SAM/data outputs are included. The final dataset deposit and its access terms remain to be confirmed separately.
notes: Software version 1.0.0 is archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23642715, preserving GitHub commit 245a17a707061151f41652efc329aa7cfa2e4d9e. The DOI covers software only. Original inputs and CFPS-derived data outputs remain governed separately by provider terms and approved deposit arrangements.
